doc: No-growth ratchets enforced by tests/quality/test_test_taxonomy.py over pytest collection of tests/. unclassified_modules: modules allowed to carry no module-level behavioral marker (unit, component or e2e). misplaced_modules: unit-marked modules under tests/integration and tests/unit modules that spawn processes. promise_exempt_modules: modules allowed to carry no pytest.mark.promise (modules that existed when the ratchet started). A collected module missing from a list fails; an entry whose module is gone or compliant is reported as stale and never fails. Entries may only be removed.
